portal: rrbapply.gov.in and the website of your RRB
sources: RRB notices and candidate login pages as seen in the recent NTPC cycles

admitCard.where: Candidate login on the RRB website or the application portal named in the notice
admitCard.when: Exam city and date slip about 10 days before, e-call letter about 4 days before your own date (pattern seen in recent cycles)
steps: Open the website of the RRB you applied to, or the candidate login the notice names, and sign in with your registration number and date of birth or password.
The exam city and date slip comes first, about 10 days before the exam in the 2026 Group D cycle. It is only for travel planning and is not an entry pass.
The e-call letter (admit card) follows about 4 days before your own date, on a rolling basis for each day's candidates.
Download the e-call letter, print it, and check the shift, reporting time, centre address and photo.
carry: The original ID proof named in the instructions
Only what the e-call letter allows. Phones, calculators and other devices are not allowed inside the hall
admitCard.note: For the typing test and the aptitude test stages, the RRB issues a separate call letter. Wait for the notice for that stage.

answerKey.summary: The official notice for the 17 September 2026 CBT 2 set its response-sheet and objection window for 24–30 September. That published window has ended; this is not a new open challenge period.
steps: Use the link in the RRB notice and sign in with your registration number and date of birth.
Open your response sheet and compare each answer with the provisional key.
To object, select the question, upload proof if the form asks for it, and pay the fee online before the last date.
The RRB decides on the objections and uses the revised key to prepare the result. It does not reply to each objection.
answerKey.fee: The retrieved notice specifies ₹50 plus applicable bank service charges per challenged question. Accepted-objection refunds are governed by that notice.
answerKey.note: The published objection window has ended. A saved response sheet shows raw responses; it is not a result or normalised-score guarantee.

result.summary: Each RRB publishes its own result as a PDF of roll numbers, and the scorecards are released through the candidate login.

stages.what: Shortlist for CBT 2, taken as a multiple of the vacancies by category. CBT 1 marks do not count in the final merit.
Merit-deciding stage. The result lists candidates for the typing test, aptitude test and document verification as the post requires.
Qualifying skill stage for posts that need it.
Final stage for allotment of posts, in merit order.

result.scorecard: The NTPC scorecard has shown the raw score, the normalised score and the qualifying status. Download and keep a copy while the link is open.
